name: dsh-redteam-gate
description: Verified-scope gate for native active tools (nmap, nuclei, ffuf, gobuster, nikto, sqlmap, Metasploit), the VibeScan and SecLayer website scans, and shell commands that invoke them. Lab hosts (loopback) allowed; other domains require DNS TXT ownership verification (domain_verify_start / domain_verify_check); fail closed.
